streams.title: Building permission
streams.description: Review renovation plans and issue property construction permits.

streams.title: Expense reimbursement
streams.description: Validate employee travel receipts and repay business trip expenses.

streams.title: Bicycle servicing
streams.description: Repair pedal bicycles, adjust gears and brakes and replace worn cycle components.

streams.title: Parcel dispatch
streams.description: Pack customer orders, print shipping labels and hand packages to the courier.

streams.title: French localization
streams.description: Translate English website pages into French for international visitors.

streams.title: Salary calculation
streams.description: Calculate monthly employee wages and payslip deductions.
